answer: In the Atlas registry, each agent identity is minted only after solving a memory-hard kernel puzzle with cost ~0.3 GPU-hours, and registering an "ember" — a lightweight sub-identity — requires burning 10 tokens, where the burn for the nth ember is 10·n² tokens. Fake identity costs thus scale quadratically: 100 embers cost 100,000 tokens, making bulk Sybil attacks economically prohibitive.
